name: f4-curv-depth-kpi-compare-model-graph
description: Read-only HTML comparison for the F4 comparison layer: reads the real GDX_HNF_CDI_COMPARE_* rows already written by F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_COMPARE_MODEL, computes Pearson r, ranks and representative persons at render time, and renders a standalone page (paired distributions, a CDIx-vs-CDIh scatter with Pearson r, representative-person bars) shaped after this project's own 'two spaces' comparison figure. Never writes to the database.
